title: Initial Runs in Integer Compositions: Lambert Series and Generalized Divisor Sums
summary: We study the initial run of equal adjacent parts in an integer composition. For a composition alpha, let P(alpha) be the common value of the parts in the initial run, let K(alpha) be the number of parts in that run, and set S(alpha)=P(alpha)K(alpha). We obtain exact finite formulas for the joint parameters (P,K,S) and the corresponding limiting laws. In the unrestricted model, each fixed event (P,K)=(p,k) reaches its limiting probability once n is above an explicit threshold.
